zh-CN:
更新内容
• 新增任务栏歌词：歌词直接显示在 Windows 任务栏中，集成封面、歌曲信息、切歌、播放/暂停与音量控制，并带实时频谱；歌词宽度可自定义，悬浮与任务栏模式的自动隐藏、翻译与发音显示分别设置
• 新增发音（音译）歌词：内置本地引擎离线生成普通话、粤语、日语、韩语音译，混合语言歌词逐行识别；翻译与发音可分别开关，支持导入与编辑 TTML 音译轨、发音 LRC
• 支持 TTML 歌词格式；歌词文件格式与来源的优先级可自由组合设置
• 播放列表新增编辑模式：多选、批量删除与拖拽排序，歌单顺序自动保存
• 修复图片背景与高级逐字歌词同时启用时的渲染冲突
• 背景着色器、动画文字与高级歌词设置改为即时生效，无需重启应用
• 修复反复切换背景着色器导致内存持续上升
• 修复部分歌曲（如网易云 M4A）标签读取错误
• 修复列表仅有一首歌时循环模式曲终停止播放
• 修复启用过高级逐字歌词后普通歌词点击跳转失效
en:
Release Notes
• Added taskbar lyrics: lyrics are displayed right in the Windows taskbar, with cover art, song info, track switching, play/pause and volume controls plus a live spectrum; the lyrics width is adjustable, and floating/taskbar modes have separate auto-hide, translation and pronunciation settings
• Added pronunciation (romanized) lyrics: a built-in offline engine romanizes Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese and Korean, with per-line detection for mixed-language lyrics; translation and pronunciation can be toggled separately, and TTML transliteration tracks or pronunciation LRC files can be imported and edited
• Added TTML lyrics support; lyric file-format and source priorities are now freely configurable
• Playlists gain an edit mode with multi-select, batch delete and drag-to-reorder; the order is saved automatically
• Fixed a rendering conflict between the image background and advanced word-by-word lyrics when both are enabled
• Background shader, animated text and advanced lyrics settings now take effect immediately, without restarting the app
• Fixed memory growth when repeatedly switching background shaders
• Fixed tag reading errors for certain songs (e.g. NetEase M4A)
• Fixed playback stopping at the end of the only song in a playlist under loop modes
• Fixed click-to-seek not working in normal lyrics after advanced word-by-word lyrics had been enabled
